text:
ada: Hey team — need temporary admin access to prod to investigate a customer-facing outage (INC-2419). Observed sustained latency + OOMs on model-serving. Requesting break-glass for 45m to inspect node-level logs and restart affected pod.

mike: Can we scope this down? Is devops-sre role insufficient?

ada: devops-sre can touch k8s resources but not node exec / sysctl changes we need. Minimal scope: kube-admin in namespace=redwood-prod + node exec on the 2 nodes in question. Will not copy data out.

irina (eng-security): @ada please paste the exact runbook steps and justification. Reminder: break-glass requires 2 approvers and session recording + audit note. Tagging @jordan @sam for approvals.

ada: Runbook (high level):
```
# 1) check pods
kubectl get pods -n redwood-prod -o wide | grep redwood-serving
# 2) capture pod logs
kubectl logs redwood-serving-3 -n redwood-prod --previous > /tmp/serve-logs.txt
# 3) node inspect (requires node exec)
ssh node-xx && dmesg | tail -n 200
# 4) restart container
kubectl rollout restart deployment/redwood-serving -n redwood-prod
# 5) if OOM visible, bump mem request and restart
kubectl patch deploy redwood-serving -n redwood-prod -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"server","resources":{"requests":{"memory":"6Gi"}}}]}}}}'
```
Justification: urgent customer impact on production inference. Need node-level diagnostics to confirm kernel OOMs.

jordan: Approved for 45m. Please ensure session recording and paste audit note back into this thread when done.

sam: Approved as well, contingent on: 1) use the `elevate` CLI (no static creds), 2) session recording on, 3) no data exfiltration.

eng-security-bot: Access ticket created: INC-2419-ELEV. Approvers: jordan, sam. Granting temporary elevation to ada. Method: elevate (ephemeral) TTL=2700s (45m). Audit session link: https://internal.recordings/redwood/INC-2419/abc123 (access logged).

ada: Starting now. Using elevate tool: `elevate --user ada --role kube-admin --namespace redwood-prod --duration 45m --reason "Investigate INC-2419 OOMs"`

ada: Quick update — executed steps 1-3, confirmed kernel OOM on node-12, restarted affected pod, bumped memory request from 4Gi -> 6Gi and triggered rollout. Observed 15% drop in tail latency immediately. No files copied outside /tmp (temporary logs only).

ada: Audit note: timestamp=1710609002; actions=[kubectl logs, ssh node-12 dmesg, kubectl patch deployment/redwood-serving], justification="Investigated sustained OOMs causing request latency"; artifacts stored in ticket INC-2419; no data export.

irina (eng-security): Thanks. Filing this into the break-glass register and attaching to INC-2419. @ada add the session recording link and the elevate request ID to the ticket. We'll follow up with a short postmortem in #postmortems.

jordan: Thanks everyone. Marking incident as investigated; recommend scheduling bump to memory in next deploy and add monitoring alert for kernel OOMs.

sam: Closing my approval after seeing audit note. If ada needs more time ping here for extension (requires another approval). :white_check_mark:

ada: Copy — will open a PR for memory bump and add runbook step for automated restart threshold. Closing elevate session now.
